walk_to.description: Pathfind and walk to grid cell (x, y) using the map's walkable cells from the data dump plus live objects. Avoids other touch triggers (doors, exits) on the way; stops early if something triggers (cutscene, dialog, scene change). Coordinates: rotated grid, up = y-1, down = y+1, left = x-1, right = x+1.

interact.description: Walk next to the object with this id (from SMSG_SCENE_ENTER / SMSG_OBJECT_UPDATE), face it and press the search/talk key. This is how you talk to NPCs and examine things.

use_item.description: Use an item (name or id) on party member `target`. Pass `facing` = an object id to walk up to and face it first: item scripts check what you are facing.

view.description: ASCII map around you: @ you, # blocked, . walkable, blank = off-map, letters = objects (listed below the map with id, kind, position).
